body: TermAl interim lane rule (Fable2, 2026-10-23, from BarA2's w-869413a422e0 diagnosis): never `cd` into another session's worktree from a Claude Bash command, not even inside a ( ) subshell. TermAl then treats the session's shell as "lost among" places that include the peer root, and the session's later commands, even `cd /other && ...`, are fenced against that root, voiding the peer's carried gate credit. Use `git -C <root>`, absolute paths, or the Read and Grep tools. Engram MCP tool calls (notes) are not affected. The rule lifts when w-869413a422e0 lands.
